source: verified stack for a small autonomous ground rover (framework + motor control + LiDAR + SLAM + navigation + chassis). Software is free/OSS; hardware prices are 2026 ballparks.

components.name: ROS 2 (Robot Operating System 2)
components.what: The robotics middleware: nodes, topics, transforms, and the ecosystem SLAM/Nav2 plug into. Program with rclpy (Python) or rclcpp (C++).

components.name: slam_toolbox
components.what: The standard ROS 2 2D LiDAR SLAM package: build and serve a live occupancy map as the rover drives.

components.name: Nav2 (Navigation2)
components.what: The ROS 2 autonomous navigation stack: costmaps, global + local planners, controllers, recovery behaviors.

components.name: rplidar_ros (Slamtec driver)
components.what: ROS driver that publishes scans from a Slamtec RPLIDAR so SLAM/Nav2 can consume them.

components.name: Slamtec RPLIDAR A1 (360° 2D LiDAR)
components.what: Affordable 360° laser scanner (~12m) that feeds the SLAM map. The rover's main sense of the world.

components.name: TB6612FNG / L298N motor driver board
components.what: H-bridge driver that lets the Pi's logic pins control the drive motors' direction and speed.
components.capability: motor driver control library + driver board

components.name: 4WD robot chassis kit (motors + wheels + frame)
components.what: The rolling base: frame, four gear motors, wheels, and battery holder to mount everything on.

components.name: Raspberry Pi 5 (4GB) + power + SD
components.what: The onboard computer that runs ROS 2, SLAM, and Nav2 on the rover.
